task.title: Relics: one damaged relic should not stop `relic list` for the others
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M23). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

One damaged relic makes `workbook relic list` and `relic list --type` fail for every relic (exit 7), whether the index is warm, cold or missing. `relic list --linked-to` handles the same relic with a warning and lists the healthy ones. The failure is documented, and it matches the behaviour before the index existed.

## Wanted

List the healthy relics and report the damaged one as a warning, the way `--linked-to` does. Decide which exit code a list with a warning returns.

## Done when

- `relic list` with one damaged relic prints the others and names the damaged one.
- `--json` carries the warning in a documented member.
- The reference describes the behaviour and the exit code.
